Door Schedule Rehab Package

This task starts from C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init.ifc. Reference images are provided on the Desktop: C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_plan.png, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_section.png. Modify the Archicad model as needed and save the required outputs as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf. Export C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt as a tab-delimited door schedule text file from the Archicad schedule/list workflow.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc with size at least 500 bytes, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf with size at least 500 bytes, and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt with size at least 20 bytes.
2. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcBuildingStorey entity and exactly 6 IfcSpace entities.
5. The IFC model contains at least 4 IfcWall entities, at least 1 IfcSlab entity, at least 1 IfcRoof entity, and at least 6 IfcDoor entities.
6. The IFC model contains spaces with exactly these normalized names: ENTRY, ROOM-A, ROOM-B, ROOM-C, ROOM-D, STORE.
7. Every listed space is assigned to the single IfcBuildingStorey.
8. The shaped IFC product bounding box is within 0.5 m of min [0.0, -0.015, -0.0479] and max [24.0, 4.0, 3.2].
9. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt is tab-delimited and has exactly these headers in this order: DoorID, DoorName, Width.
10. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt has exactly 6 data rows in this order: DR-01 DOOR-ENTRY 1.1, DR-02 DOOR-A 0.95, DR-03 DOOR-B 0.9, DR-04 DOOR-C 0.95, DR-05 DOOR-D 1.0, DR-06 DOOR-STORE 0.85, with numeric values matching within tolerance +/-0.10.
11. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf has exactly 1 page and extracted text contains at least these case-insensitive tokens: A101, PLAN, DOOR SCHEDULE REHAB, DOOR-ENTRY, DOOR-A, DOOR-STORE.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
